description: This file is a shell script that contains functions, test setups, and sequences for interacting with Perforce (p4) and git-p4, mainly focusing on shelve, unshelve, and changelist operations. It appears to be a test or automation script for verifying p4 and git-p4 behaviors related to shelved changes.

methods.name: last_shelved_change
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change number from p4.

methods.name: shelve_one_file
methods.description: Creates a new shelved changelist for a specified file with a standard description.
